evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息， 苹果今日向 Mac 电脑用户推送了 macOS 27.2 RC 更新（内部版本号：26B118） ，本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 6 天。 苹果 macOS 27.2 RC 这次主要带来 Siri AI 新语言支持、亮度和音量滑块更新，以及内置应用的触控手势底层改动。Siri AI 方面，新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持。 视觉方面，苹果加入了新的亮度和音量滑块，现在使用实心符号。 此外 macOS 27.2 内部代码显示 Safari、备忘录、照片和快速查看等应用出现新的触控手势识别相关代码。 此前 Beta 4 被报告存在一个问题：部分基于 Electron 的应用，其窗口会随机无法拖动，重启 Mac 可以暂时恢复。不过，当前 RC 报道尚未确认该问题是否已经修复。 此外，苹果开始向开发者及公测用户推送 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 和 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 的第三个发布候选版本（RC 3）。苹果给出的更新说明较为简短，仅表示新版本包含“重要的安全修复”，并“推荐所有用户安装”。报道尚未提供具体漏洞、受影响组件或修复细节。 如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？ • 公开测试版 ：需注册 Apple Beta 版软件计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级； • 开发预览版 ：需登录注册 苹果开发者计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。 苹果今日向 Mac 电脑用户推送了 macOS 27.2 RC 更新（内部版本号：26B118），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 6 天。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，苹果今日向 Mac 电脑用户推送了 macOS 27.2 RC 更新（内部版本号：26B118），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 6 天。
苹果 macOS 27.2 RC 这次主要带来 Siri AI 新语言支持、亮度和音量滑块更新，以及内置应用的触控手势底层改动。Siri AI 方面，新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持。
视觉方面，苹果加入了新的亮度和音量滑块，现在使用实心符号。
此外 macOS 27.2 内部代码显示 Safari、备忘录、照片和快速查看等应用出现新的触控手势识别相关代码。
此前 Beta 4 被报告存在一个问题：部分基于 Electron 的应用，其窗口会随机无法拖动，重启 Mac 可以暂时恢复。不过，当前 RC 报道尚未确认该问题是否已经修复。
此外，苹果开始向开发者及公测用户推送 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 和 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 的第三个发布候选版本（RC 3）。苹果给出的更新说明较为简短，仅表示新版本包含“重要的安全修复”，并“推荐所有用户安装”。报道尚未提供具体漏洞、受影响组件或修复细节。
如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？
• 公开测试版：需注册 Apple Beta 版软件计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级；
• 开发预览版：需登录注册苹果开发者计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。

微软在 10 月 15 日发布的更新日志中，表示：
我们也在不断改进您日常依赖的交互体验。蓝牙耳机在 Windows 系统上的表现更加稳定可靠，配对、重新连接、音频播放和通话都更加流畅，AirPods 的配对时间最多可缩短 15 秒。
补充说明中写道：
该改进已整合到 Windows 11 操作系统版本 26200.8737 ；实际性能可能因 Apple AirPods 型号、设备配置、使用情况和其他因素而异。

units.text: HomePod 27.2 Adds Sound Glow to Existing HomePod Models

Apple's latest software update for the HomePod brings a new Sound Glow feature to the ‌HomePod‌, ‌HomePod‌ mini, and HomePod mini 2. Apple introduced Sound Glow as a ‌HomePod mini 2‌ feature, but it's available for the second-generation ‌HomePod‌ and the original ‌HomePod‌ mini too.

‌HomePod‌ Software 27.2 is available as a release candidate update for developers and public beta testers, but it should launch next week. Once you've updated your ‌HomePod‌ or ‌HomePod‌ mini to the new software, you can go to the ‌HomePod‌ settings to turn on Sound Glow. If your HomePods are paired with an Apple TV, you can also use the ‌Apple TV‌ Control Center to turn Sound Glow on or off.

With Sound Glow, the top of a ‌HomePod‌ or ‌HomePod‌ mini lights up with color that pulses in sync with the music or audio that's playing. The feature draws colors from album artwork, and it works with songs, podcasts, Apple's ambient music feature, and more.
Sound Glow is not available on the original ‌HomePod‌.

‌HomePod‌ Software 27.2 also adds support for using HomePods as the default speaker for a Mac, support for using for HomePods or ‌HomePod‌ mini 2s as surround sound for an ‌Apple TV‌, and it adds a Lock Controls feature for disabling touch interactions with the top of the ‌HomePod‌.

units.text: Apple has released the first iOS 27.2 release candidate for iPhone. The update brings Apple’s next iPhone software release one step closer to its public launch.
iOS 27.2 reaches release candidate stage

After several beta versions, Apple is putting the final touches on iOS 27.2. If testing doesn’t uncover anything that requires another build, the release candidate could be the version that reaches everyone.
View all comments
The beta cycle has introduced Group FaceTime Dual Capture, more Siri AI languages, Apple TV app profiles, and changes to how Apple Podcasts organizes episodes.
Apple Music also has a new app icon and updated color scheme. The black-and-white icon replaces the familiar red design, while blue now highlights the active tab inside the app.

One feature that Apple pulled from testing is the overhauled Health app. It appeared in earlier iOS 27.2 betas before Apple restored the previous Health app in beta 4. The upgrade is still planned for release later this year.
We’ll update our coverage with any notable changes discovered in the release candidate. Spot anything new in iOS 27.2 RC? Let us know in the comments below!

units.text: 10月19日，彭博社知名苹果记者马克·古尔曼(Mark Gurman)周日发文称，虽然Apple Intelligence家居中枢设备HomeView最近才发布，但是它的研发早已完成，为了等待配套软件Siri只能在仓库里“吃灰”，硬件已显得过时。
HomeView
HomeView可谓姗姗来迟，比苹果原本预期的晚了很久。古尔曼最早在2023年1月报道过这款设备，当时苹果的目标是最早在2024年底将其推向市场。这本应是一次相对顺利的发布，结果却变成了一场长达近两年的跳票连续剧。罪魁祸首是苹果的AI危机，这让公司缺少了HomeView绝对必需的一项技术：一个可用的、改版后的Siri助手。
从一开始，HomeView就是围绕新版Siri设计的。这款语音助手需要能够调取用户的个人内容，识别家庭中的不同成员，并向每个人展示各自的私人信息。此外，HomeView的设计初衷是主要通过语音而非触摸屏进行操控。如果没有一款能够正常使用的新版Siri，苹果就无法实现最初设想的用户体验。这导致HomeView的硬件早已准备就绪，软件开发却远未完成。
于是，苹果一再推迟HomeView的发布时间，最初计划于2025年春季推出，随后推迟至夏季、秋季，进入2026年后又多次延期，直到上周才终于正式发布。这款产品的硬件配置也暴露了它的年代感。厚厚的屏幕边框、A18处理器和8GB内存，都清楚地表明这是一款多年前就已开始构思的产品。实际上，成品设备早已装箱入库，在仓库里存放了大半年，等待软件开发进度赶上硬件。
有一个证据能说明这款产品已开发了很久：前苹果员工在社交媒体上发布了多条帖子，他们自豪地炫耀自己参与HomeView的工作。这些人并不是刚离职的。有些人已经离开苹果相当长一段时间了，却仍然能把这款新发布的设备称为自己参与打造的作品。这足以说明，这款产品的许多研发工作早在很久以前就已完成。

话虽如此，HomeView的299美元售价还是挺有竞争力的。古尔曼称，苹果可能受益于提前囤积库存，在今年早些时候内存短缺推高零部件成本之前就完成了备货，从而得以将售价控制在这一水平。如今，入门级iPad的起售价已达到450美元，而iPad mini也即将迎来大幅涨价。相比之下，对于大多数智能家居应用场景而言，HomeView及其内置的扬声器系统比iPad更加合适。这款产品的性价比之高，令人颇感意外。
但是，HomeView也提前预告了苹果一项雄心更大的计划。苹果已经在开发一款更高端的版本，配备机械臂，可以自动将屏幕转向正在说话的人。有趣的是，苹果为这款售价299美元的HomeView制作的广告，恰恰有力地说明了为什么需要这样一款能够自动转动屏幕的升级版产品。

10月19日，彭博社知名苹果记者马克·古尔曼(Mark Gurman)周日发文称，虽然Apple Intelligence家居中枢设备HomeView最近才发布，但是它的研发早已完成，为了等待配套软件Siri只能在仓库里“吃灰”，硬件已显得过时。
HomeView可谓姗姗来迟，比苹果原本预期的晚了很久。古尔曼最早在2023年1月报道过这款设备，当时苹果的目标是最早在2024年底将其推向市场。这本应是一次相对顺利的发布，结果却变成了一场长达近两年的跳票连续剧。罪魁祸首是苹果的AI危机，这让公司缺少了HomeView绝对必需的一项技术：一个可用的、改版后的Siri助手。
于是，苹果一再推迟HomeView的发布时间，最初计划于2025年春季推出，随后推迟至夏季、秋季，进入2026年后又多次延期，直到上周才终于正式发布。这款产品的硬件配置也暴露了它的年代感。厚厚的屏幕边框、A18处理器和8GB内存，都清楚地表明这是一款多年前就已开始构思的产品。实际上，成品设备早已装箱入库，在仓库里存放了大半年，等待软件开发进度赶上硬件。

话虽如此，HomeView的299美元售价还是挺有竞争力的。古尔曼称，苹果可能受益于提前囤积库存，在今年早些时候内存短缺推高零部件成本之前就完成了备货，从而得以将售价控制在这一水平。如今，入门级iPad的起售价已达到450美元，而iPad mini也即将迎来大幅涨价。相比之下，对于大多数智能家居应用场景而言，HomeView及其内置的扬声器系统比iPad更加合适。这款产品的性价比之高，令人颇感意外。
但是，HomeView也提前预告了苹果一项雄心更大的计划。苹果已经在开发一款更高端的版本，配备机械臂，可以自动将屏幕转向正在说话的人。有趣的是，苹果为这款售价299美元的HomeView制作的广告，恰恰有力地说明了为什么需要这样一款能够自动转动屏幕的升级版产品。

units.text: Apple has sent invites to a second product launch this month, and it’s scheduled for October 28th at 1PM ET in Los Angeles.

At the event, Apple is set to announce new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini, according to Bloomberg. The big announcement is expected to be a new MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen that’s also lighter and has an iPhone-like Dynamic Island. But Apple is also planning on revealing a 14-inch MacBook Pro and a new iMac with the M6 chip, which was recently introduced with the Mac Mini. Apple’s updated iPad Mini will apparently finally get an OLED screen as well and put the selfie cam on the landscape edge.
“Can’t wait to pro and tell next week,” Apple’s SVP Marketing Greg Joswiak says in a teaser on X.
[Media: https://twitter.com/gregjoz/status/2112212372182249831]

This second October launch follows Apple’s smart home-focused “Welcome home” event on October 13th, which included the new HomeView smart home hub, an updated Apple TV 4K and Siri Remote, and a second-generation HomePod Mini.

evidence.title: Constrained iPhone Duo availability is annoying, but a mixed blessing for Apple

units.text: Estimated iPhone Duo delivery dates started slipping dramatically, literally within a minute of pre-orders opening on Friday. Even some of those who got in within the first few minutes got estimated shipping dates into January of next year.

That undeniably poses problems for Apple, but some have gone as far as calling it “a major mistake” to launch with such limited stock. Personally, I’d say it’s annoying for customers but more of a mixed blessing for Apple …
Apple always builds up inventory before launching new products, but with new product categories like the first foldable iPhone it can be hard for the company to predict demand.

In many ways, the company is in a no-win position with this balancing act of supply and demand. If demand greatly exceeds supply, Apple risks irritating some of its most loyal customers – those who are willing to go all in on a first-generation product. But if supply exceeds demand, and a new product remains available for immediate delivery, commenters will inevitably point to that as evidence for it being a flop.
The balance of supply and demand

In truth, none of us knows the true position here. The imbalance may be due to the iPhone Duo being wildly more popular than Apple anticipated (as the company implies), or it may be that demand is modest but manufacturing complexities mean that supply is even more limited. My own view is that it’s likely a mixture of the two: relatively high demand and rather constrained supply.

Relatively high demand because, while foldables in general are still a rather niche product, it’s very clear that Apple put in a lot of thought and work into making this one the best on the market. The company has seemingly addressed the two main issues that beset Android foldables to date: a visible crease and poor durability. The company then created software features to take full advantage of the form factor of the device, and topped it off with an absolutely superb launch video. I think some of those who had previously ruled it out on the basis of price changed their minds once they saw it; It’s been a long time since we’ve seen such excitement levels around a new Apple product.

Rather constrained supply because it’s clear that the complexity of the device, and most especially the hinge, means that it’s very difficult to manufacture, and it’s likely that yield rates are relatively low.
A mixed blessing

One of the biggest problems of the world we live in today is polarization of views. Large swathes of the population seem to have lost sight of the fact that two different things can be true at the same time.
View all comments

Yes, pre-ordering a product in October within minutes and then having to wait until January to receive it is both annoying and frustrating. If I were in that position, I would absolutely be pissed at Apple.
But also yes: this immediate slipping of delivery dates adds to the narrative of a wildly popular new product, serving to further boost the hype around it.

If Apple could have perfectly predicted demand, then it would likely have wanted a position where delivery times slipped sufficiently for the launch to be viewed as a success, but not so much that customers get annoyed. This situation isn’t ideal, for sure, but in my view it’s more of a mixed blessing than a strategic error.

Finally, if you are the position of having been given a lengthy wait for your order, the reality may not be quite as bad as it appears. Apple tends to present customers with the worst case dates initially, often bringing them forward subsequently. Additionally, retail staff tell me that there will often be unexpected walk-in stock available at some stores, again due to imperfect forecasting of online versus offline sales, as well as varying demand at different stores. That’s always worth trying from the day after the new devices go on sale.

units.text: 【点此直达升级教程】
IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，苹果今日向 Apple Watch 用户推送了 watchOS 27.2 RC 更新（内部版本号：24S116），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 6 天。
目前苹果公开的 RC 开发者说明主要列出了应用内购买测试相关修复，尚未列出面向普通用户的新表盘、健康或运动功能。
苹果的 watchOS 27.2 RC 发布说明列出以下三项修复，均属于 StoreKit 应用内购买测试工具，主要影响开发者测试订阅与购买流程：
订阅优惠资格重置：修复调用 SKTestSession.clearTransactions() 清除测试交易后，首次订阅优惠资格未立即重置的问题。
商店地区与语言变更：修复通过 SKTestSession 更改商店地区或区域设置后，变更未通过 Storefront.updates 传递的问题。
测试购买错误弹窗：修复已将 dialogsDisabled 设为 true，购买失败时仍可能弹出错误对话框的问题。
已知问题方面，在应用内购买属于“订阅组合”的某项订阅后，系统可能错误地允许用户拆分订阅。苹果仍将此列为已知问题，尚未标记为修复。
目前没有足够明确的官方资料，能确认这次 RC 新增了哪些日常可见功能，或具体改善了续航、流畅度及健康监测。
如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？
• 公开测试版：需注册 Apple Beta 版软件计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级；
• 开发预览版：需登录注册苹果开发者计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。

units.text: The EU’s List of Acquisitions website was updated today with details of a deal struck in June between Apple and Samplab, a Swiss startup that described itself as offering “music production for the age of AI.” Here are the details.
Apple’s string of AI deals continues

Last week, the List of Acquisitions section of the EU’s DMA website was updated with details on Apple’s move to acqui-hire Huxe, a startup founded by former NotebookLM engineers that specialized in generating personalized audio briefings and podcast-style content using AI.
Today, the list was updated yet again, revealing another deal involving Apple and an AI audio company.

Apple Inc. (“Apple”), through a subsidiary, will acquire certain assets of Samplab GmbH (“Samplab”) and offer employment to and hire certain Samplab employees. Samplab develops audio editing tools. Apple (together with its group companies) designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.
Following the deal, Samplab’s website now redirects to Apple’s, while its social media accounts and YouTube channel appear to have been scrubbed of their previous posts and videos.

Previously, Samplab’s website described its “ultimate audio editor for musicians” as a tool that allowed creators to “edit audio files as if you were working with MIDI.” It also touted its ability to:
Detect and edit chords They stay in key when you change them. You can even export them as a midi file.
Make any samples sound good together Samplab matches their tempo and key. Easily adapt chords, melodies and drums.
Granular stem separation Separate stems in any audio and freely modify individual notes.

While Apple has not commented on the acquisition, it isn’t hard to imagine Samplab’s technology eventually making its way into Logic Pro or GarageBand, or even enhancing the audio editing capabilities of Final Cut Pro.
What do you think Apple will do with Samplab’s technology? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: Apple Watch sleep apnea notifications launched two years ago. Since then, the health feature has been quietly working in the background and making a difference for people who may not know they need it.
Apple Watch Ultra flagged a serious health issue for an Air Force veteran
A new story from Military.com highlights one such case involving David Aladejobi, a 38-year-old Air Force veteran whose Apple Watch alerted him to possible sleep apnea.

Aladejobi initially brushed off the possible sleep apnea Apple Watch notification. After thinking about his snoring, however, he contacted his doctor and shared a screenshot of the alert. He had also been experiencing headaches that his doctor suspected could be related to sleep.
“I got the notification saying, you may have sleep apnea through the watch. I didn’t really think much about it. But then, I started thinking about how I was snoring and stuff like that.

So, I contacted my doctor and sent a screenshot of what the watch was saying,” Aladejobi said, in an interview with Military.com. “I was also having headaches and my doctor was saying it might be because of sleep.”
A sleep apnea diagnosis followed, along with a referral to a sleep lab and a prescription for a CPAP machine to help regulate his breathing overnight.

“Yeah, my doctor said undiagnosed sleep apnea, if not treated, can definitely lead to death or other health problems like high blood pressure,” he said. “So using something as simple as a watch that’s already being worn and already paid for, and then being urged to see a doctor. That was huge. Why not pay attention to something like that?”
How sleep apnea notifications work

Apple Watch uses its accelerometer to identify breathing disturbances during sleep. The feature evaluates those disturbances over a 30-day period and can notify users when the data shows consistent signs of moderate to severe sleep apnea.

Apple says users need to enable sleep tracking and wear a compatible Apple Watch to bed for at least 10 nights during that period. Notifications are intended for adults who haven’t already been diagnosed with sleep apnea.
The notification itself isn’t a diagnosis. Like for Aladejobi, it provides a reason to contact a doctor about symptoms and potentially get treatment for an otherwise unknown condition.
Apple Watch possible sleep apnea notifications work with Apple Watch SE 3, Apple Watch Series 9 or later, and Apple Watch Ultra 2 or later.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，据长期关注国内手机市场份额的数码博主 @RD观测 爆料，截至 2026 年第 41 周（10 月 5 日-10 月 11 日），苹果旗舰 iPhone 18 Pro 系列的销量约 408.09 万台。
作为对比，该博主此前透露，iPhone 18 Pro 在第 40 周时，销量为 289.09 万台，这意味着该系列机型实现了周增百万台的突破。
另外，博主 @数码闲聊站 此前爆料称，iPhone 18 Pro Max 又刷新纪录了，W41（此处指 2026 年的第 41 个自然周，即 10 月 5 日至 10 月 11 日）单周单品激活近 90 万（此处及下文预计指国内激活量 / 销量）。
参考IT之家此前报道，在 9 月 10 日的苹果 2026 年秋季发布会上，iPhone 18 Pro 系列正式发布，包括 18 Pro 和 18 Pro Max，起售价分别为 9999 元和 10999 元。
iPhone 18 Pro 系列首发搭载 2 纳米制程工艺 A20 Pro 芯片，其封装方式借鉴了 M 系列芯片，性能和能效均创 iPhone 新高。两款机型均配备更小的灵动岛，全新 4800 万像素融合式主摄配备可变光圈。

Continuing Apple’s weekly RC rollouts for older macOS versions ahead of their official release, Apple is now rolling out the third release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, in addition to the first RC for macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.
Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 late last month, both of which saw two RCs before the official rollout.
So far, Apple’s release notes for the third macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RCs mention only that they bring “important security fixes” and are “recommended for all users.”

Apple will likely detail the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 after their official release, which will likely come alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate within the next few weeks.
The release build for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 3 is 24H230, while the release build for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 3 is 25G330.
Did you spot anything new or different in today’s RCs? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: 苹果宣布将于10月28日举行产品发布活动，并于周一向媒体和分析师发出邀请，活动名为“Apple Experience in Los Angeles”。邮件中写着“Pro and tell”，暗示此次发布将聚焦于搭载强大自研芯片的高端“Pro”设备。
Melius Research分析师Ben Reitzes周一在报告中写道，他预计今年秋季将推出新款Mac，“包括一款触屏笔记本”。他表示，对于上月接替Tim Cook出任首席执行官的John Ternus而言，这样的发布节奏标志着相比以往每年两场活动的“重大转变”。
这将是Ternus短暂任期内苹果的第三场发布活动。此前，苹果在公司总部举行了一场活动，发布新款iPhone，包括折叠屏Duo；随后又在纽约举行了一场活动，重点围绕智能家居中枢以及一款名为HomeView的带屏新音箱。
苹果在8月为Mac Mini和Mac Studio台式机更新了芯片，并在春季更新了MacBook Pro，同时推出了新的低成本机型MacBook Neo。但苹果的iMac台式机自2024年10月以来一直没有更新。
最近一个季度，苹果Mac销售额约占整体营收的10%，公司仍高度依赖iPhone。
尽管如此，得益于其芯片能够以高于其他消费级处理器的速度访问更多内存，Mac已成为苹果人工智能故事中最强劲的部分之一。苹果股价今年迄今上涨26%，跑赢标普500指数。
上周，苹果与Meta合作，将Meta开发的一个大型开放权重模型引入多台高端Mac Studio。
苹果历史上一直对触屏笔记本电脑不以为然，软件主管Craig Federighi曾在2018年解释称，这种设计的人体工学体验会让用户疲劳。

units.text: The first release candidates for iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and macOS 27.2 have arrived for testing.

The first release candidates for iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, watchOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, and HomePod Software 27.2 have surfaced, following four developer beta cycles, three for tvOS 27.2 and HomePod Software 27.2.

While a release candidate or RC version means the update is practically at the state it will be distributed to the general public, there's no guarantee it will be the only one. A second RC is always a possibility.

The first major post-milestone update is normally a point-one version, which unusually isn't the case this time. As the iOS 27.1 build is designated to be used with the iPhone Duo, that version is being skipped for the non-foldable iPhone models.
The new 27.2 builds are:
iOS 27.2 RC 1 is 24B115, replacing 24B5110a
iPadOS 27.2 RC 1 is 24B115, replacing 24B5110a
macOS 27.2 RC 1 is 26B118, replacing 26B5112a
watchOS 27.2 RC 1 is 24S116, replacing 24S5112a
visionOS 27.2 RC 1 is 24N118, replacing 24N5114a
tvOS 27.2 RC 1 is 24K120, replacing 24K5103f
HomePod Software 27.2 RC 1 is 24K120, replacing 24K5103f
Apple has also released RC builds for older operating systems:
macOS 15.8.2. RC 3 is build 24H230, replacing 24H225
macOS 26.7.2 RC 3 is build 25G330, replacing 25G325
iOS 26.7.2 RC 1 is build 23H127
iPadOS 26.7.2 RC 1 is 23H127

The RC round arrives after the fourth developer betas, which were distributed on October 5. However, while there were builds for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS, the round didn't include builds for tvOS nor HomePod Software.
The third round was shared by Apple on October 5. The second appeared on September 21, and the first round landed on September 16.
The first round introduced a few changes to iOS 27.2, including a redesigned Health app, which works alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12.
FaceTime gained dual capture support, Siri AI added localization for multiple languages, and Apple TV profiles from tvOS 26.2 came over to the iPhone.

The second build had indications of a new AutoLock security feature, which locks down an iPhone if it is detected to have been snatched or otherwise stolen from the owner. The feature isn't accessible to testers, but it was spotted as running in the background in a non-functional manner.

The fourth iOS 27.2 beta had Apple Music change its icon to black and white, as well as a withdrawal of the redesign of the Apple Health app in favor of a later release. HomePods also gained a new setting to Lock Controls.

AppleInsider warns readers trying out beta software should do so on secondary, spare hardware instead of their mission-critical or daily driver devices. There is always a risk of buggy, broken, or other potentially harmful elements in beta software, which can be a risk to your data.
Members of the public should seek out the public betas instead of the developer versions as safer alternatives. In either case, it is also advisable to keep up-to-date backups on hand.
Find any changes in the new builds? Reach out to us on X at @AppleInsider or @Andrew_OSU, or send Andrew an email at [email protected].

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月19日消息， 近期，一则消息称iPhone17标准版出现相机控制按键掉漆的用户可以享受免费更换中框以及电池的维修待遇，该说法在社交平台被大量转发。 不少手持iPhone17标准版的用户看到传闻后，纷纷关心自己设备出现按键掉漆是否能够直接享受全套免费维修。 针对网上流传的维修说法，官方客服给出了明确回应， 目前并没有推出针对相机按键掉漆问题的专项免费维修计划，网传的直接免费更换中框加电池并不是统一执行的官方政策。 客服表示，设备最终能不能走免费保修，不能仅凭按键掉漆这一现象直接判定，需要把设备送至官方服务网点，由工程师做现场检测之后，才可以得出维修结论。 按键位置出现掉漆要区分情况，如果只是日常使用磨损带来的外观涂层损耗，按照保修规则，这类外观损伤一般不在免费保修范围内。只有检测判定掉漆属于产品本身材料或者工艺缺陷，才能够启动对应的保修服务。 同时关于电池免费更换，官方也有固定标准，正常情况下，只有电池健康度下降至80%以下，才满足保内免费更换电池的条件，单纯的按键掉漆，并不会附带触发电池免费更换服务。 网传的免费更换案例，只是个别用户经过检测后达成的个案处理结果，并不代表所有出现同类外观现象的机器都可以照搬这套维修方案。 快科技10月19日消息，近期，一则消息称iPhone17标准版出现相机控制按键掉漆的用户可以享受免费更换中框以及电池的维修待遇，该说法在社交平台被大量转发。

evidence.title: Apple is launching major new products next week, here’s what’s coming - 9to5Mac

units.text: Apple just introduced HomeView alongside a new Apple TV and HomePod mini, but another product unveiling is already set for next week. Here are the new products expected to launch at Apple’s ‘Pro and tell’ event on October 28, including major updates to MacBook Pro and iPad mini.
MacBook Pro redesign with OLED, touchscreen, Dynamic Island, more
Apple has a new MacBook Pro coming next week that’s expected to be the star of the ‘Pro and tell’ event. Rumored features include:
Industrial redesign that’s much lighter and slightly thinner
OLED display
Touchscreen
M5 Pro and M5 Max chips
No notch, just a hole-punch camera cutout and Dynamic Island

This new model isn’t expected to replace Apple’s current MacBook Pro models, but rather debut as a new, higher-end option. Early rumors suggested it could be called ‘MacBook Ultra,’ but with the event tagline using ‘Pro’ that seems unlikely.
iPad mini with A20 Pro, OLED, redesigned camera setup
The iPad mini is also expected to get a big update. An OLED display will be one of the tentpole new features, making it the only iPad model to gain OLED besides the iPad Pro.

Apple is reportedly bringing its flagship A20 Pro chip from iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo to the iPad mini. The front-facing camera is also being moved to prioritize landscape use rather than the current portrait orientation.
We’re also expecting improved water resistance and a more powerful speaker system.
iMac with M6 chip and refreshed colors
The iMac is still running an M4 chip, but a new M6 model is rumored to debut next week.

We’re not expecting many changes with the new iMac, as the M6 chip will be the central upgrade. Like with the M6 Mac mini (currently on sale), the iMac will gain a 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, and Dual 16-core Neural Engine.
Apple also has a refreshed slate of color options coming to the M6 iMac too.
14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
In addition to the redesigned MacBook Pro with touchscreen, Apple is expected to launch a new entry-level MacBook Pro with M6 chip that’s only available in a 14-inch model.
Similar to how Apple introduced a new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5 last fall, we’re expecting an update to that entry model that doesn’t change much besides the M6 chip.
The M6 MacBook Pro will have the same design as the current models, and the same display technology, but be more powerful and potentially gain battery life due to the more efficient M6.
Which new products next week are you interested in buying? Let us know in the comments.
*Buy Mac with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

但华为和苹果两家反而实现逆势上涨，合计占据40%的市场份额，进一步拉开了与竞争对手的差距。
市场整体下滑，一部分原因是存储元器件涨价，手机制造成本抬升，不少新机售价跟着往上走。现在手机硬件升级感知不强，很多用户觉得没必要频繁换机，换机周期被拉长，大家更愿意等到大促再考虑换新。
大盘走低的同时，市场格局发生明显变化。华为凭借折叠屏、阔直板等多款新品，覆盖高端、中端多个价位段，出货量拿到19%的同比增长，以21.3%的份额冲到国内市场第一位。
中国前六大智能手机品牌出货量占比
报告指出，然而，华为自9月1日起正式上调了产品价格，这可能会给未来的销售带来进一步压力。
苹果方面，以19.5%的市场份额位居第二，iPhone 18 Pro系列市场反响不错，上市前三周的销量较iPhone 17 Pro系列同比增长了 23.5%。
基础款iPhone 18的发布推迟，促使部分消费者转而购买Pro系列机型，从而助推了Pro系列初期的销售势头。
简单来说，现在国内手机市场两极分化越来越明显。愿意花钱买高端机的用户，更多流向华为、苹果。普通消费群体，面对涨价的新机，选择继续用旧手机，不着急更新。
机构也提到，9月份安卓旗舰集中发布，会给第四季度带来一定拉动。但存储成本居高不下，很难指望市场马上迎来大幅反弹。
后续各大厂商会更多靠AI功能、特殊屏幕形态，来刺激用户换新意愿。

evidence.title: iPhone Duo battery capacity lands in between iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max

units.text: Apple has published the overall capacity of the two-battery iPhone Duo in a regulatory filing, showing exactly how it compares to the iPhone 18 Pro and more.

Initial rumors claimed that the iPhone Duo would have the largest battery capacity of any iPhone ever made. Then real-world tests showed it performs practically the same as the iPhone 18 Pro, but now the figures are out.
As reported by Apple in its EU Energy Labels regulatory filing, the iPhone Duo's battery capacity is 4883 mAh.
For comparison, that beats the iPhone 18 Pro but is short of the battery in the iPhone 18 Pro Max. In decreasing order of battery capacity, Apple's most recent iPhones are:
iPhone 18 Pro Max 5391 mAh
iPhone Duo 4883 mAh
iPhone 17 Pro Max 4823 mAh
iPhone 18 Pro 4056 mAh
iPhone 17e 4005 mAh
iPhone 16e 4005 mAh
iPhone 17 Pro 3988 mAh
iPhone 17 3692 mAh
iPhone Air 3149 mAh

Apple's filing does not detail how the iPhone Duo's total battery capacity is spread over two batteries. However, the figure of 4883 mAh is precisely what was rumored in July 2026, when reports said the device's two batteries would be 1921 mAh and 2962 mAh.
Real-world performance

Until the iPhone Duo is shipping and can be tested there are few Geekbench results. But the first one on the site showed that despite the difference in battery capacities, the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro performed remarkably similarly.
This makes sense, given that they use the same processor.

Where the iPhone 18 Pro scored 3390 in Geekbench 7's single-core tests, the iPhone Duo was 3986. Then for for demanding multi-core work, the iPhone 18 Pro scored 11,540 while the iPhone Duo hit 11,067.
Both comparison results were within the margin of error. This means that in use, the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro should perform indistinguishably.

units.text: Apple's October 28 'Pro and Tell' Launch: What's Coming

Apple will announce a second wave of new products on Wednesday, October 28. Like the October 13 "Welcome Home" announcement, "Pro and Tell" isn't going to be a traditional Apple event, but some members of the media have been invited to Los Angeles to get hands-on time with the new devices.

Everyone not invited to Los Angeles will get to see the product announcements via press releases that come out on October 28. Apple could send out press releases at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, which is when the media experience will begin. Press release announcements typically come out earlier in the morning around 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time, so that's also a possibility.
The "Pro and Tell" name gives us a strong hint at what's coming: the MacBook Pro. It will be joined by other new Macs and a new iPad.

New high-end ‌MacBook Pro‌ models are coming with two firsts for the Mac line: OLED display technology and a touchscreen. Design changes are expected too, but the new ‌MacBook Pro‌ models are going to use the same chips as the current version.
OLED - The ‌MacBook Pro‌ will have an ‌OLED‌ display for improved contrast, richer colors, and power savings.

Touchscreen - macOS 27 is being updated for touch-based gestures, and the ‌MacBook Pro‌ will be the first Mac that has touchscreen capabilities. Touch will be available as a supplementary option alongside the trackpad and keyboard, so you can presumably opt not to use it at all.
Reinforced hinge - Apple is adding a sturdier hinge for support so the display won't move when you tap on the screen.

Design - There's only so much that can be changed when it comes to a notebook computer, but the ‌MacBook Pro‌ will be lighter than the current model. Sizes aren't expected to change, and ‌OLED‌ screens will be available for both the 14-inch and 16-inch models.
Dynamic Island - Apple is getting rid of the notch and will add a Dynamic Island instead.

Chips - Apple isn't adding new chips because there aren't any. The company is reportedly skipping the M6 Pro and M6 Max, and the M7 Pro and M7 Max won't be ready until late 2027. Rumors suggest the new models will use the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chips as the models introduced in March.

Apple might keep selling the current ‌MacBook Pro‌ models and add the ‌OLED‌ models as a higher-end, more expensive option. While there were rumors suggesting the ‌OLED‌ MacBook would be called the MacBook Ultra, it's now clear Apple is sticking with Pro.
‌OLED‌ displays are expensive, and touch modules also add cost, so the ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Pro‌ models will likely cost more than the current ‌MacBook Pro‌ models.
Entry-Level MacBook Pro
The 14-inch entry-level ‌MacBook Pro‌ is expected to get an M6 chip to replace the M5 chip it was updated with in October 2025. No other design changes are expected.
iMac
Rumors suggest Apple will update the 24-inch iMac with an M6 chip too. As with the entry-level ‌MacBook Pro‌, it won't get external changes.
iPad mini 8
Along with the new Macs that are coming, we're expecting an iPad mini update. The ‌iPad mini‌ 8 is going to get an ‌OLED‌ display, making it the first ‌iPad‌ other than the iPad Pro to adopt ‌OLED‌.

It's also going to get a design refresh with a vibration-based speaker setup that eliminates speaker holes and allows for a more water-resistant design. It could be the first ‌iPad‌ with an IP rating, able to hold up to splashes and possibly even submersion.

The ‌iPad mini‌ 8 is expected to use the same A20 Pro chip that's in the iPhone 18 Pro models. It's so far unclear whether the ‌iPad mini‌ will continue to have a 60Hz refresh rate or if it will get a 120Hz ProMotion upgrade. The front camera will relocated from the portrait side to the landscape side, a change Apple previously made in other ‌iPad‌ models.
Waterproofing and ‌OLED‌ are expected to push up the price, so the new model could cost around $200 more than the current $599 model.
Launch Date

After an October 28 debut, the new Mac and ‌iPad‌ options could launch as soon as November 6. If this launch goes like the home product launch, the devices will be available for pre-order starting on October 28.

units.text: 快科技10月19日消息，市场研究机构Omdia最新数据显示，2026年第三季度印度智能手机出货量约为3580万台，同比大幅下降26%，创下2016年以来第三季度出货量新低。
尽管印度迎来传统节日促销季，但依然未能扭转智能手机市场的下滑趋势。
Omdia指出，手机价格持续上涨、消费者支出趋于谨慎，导致换机需求受到抑制，厂商也因此采取更加保守的库存策略。
与此同时，线上渠道出货疲软，加上今年印度排灯节时间较晚，部分线下渠道的节日备货需求从9月推迟至10月，进一步加剧了第三季度市场的下滑。
市场排名方面，三星以670万台的出货量重夺印度智能手机市场第一，这也是三星自2024年第一季度以来首次登顶。
vivo以640万台的出货量位居第二，OPPO以490万台排名第三，小米以470万台位居第四，苹果则以390万台排名第五。
Omdia分析师表示，印度智能手机市场正在发生变化，过去依靠线上渠道和节日促销拉动出货量的模式正面临挑战。
随着线上独家新品减少、低价机型供应有限，以及线上线下促销优惠差距缩小，中国手机厂商此前积累的线上渠道优势有所减弱。
相比之下，三星和苹果凭借高端产品布局、渠道合作，以及以旧换新、分期付款等促销措施，进一步巩固了市场地位。
展望后续市场走势，Omdia预计，2027年印度智能手机出货量仍可能出现低个位数百分比的下滑，手机价格上涨压力预计至少持续至2027年上半年。

units.text: 海外开发者 Makr（@makrotasuss）展示了一项相当特别的系统移植成果：成功让 Redmi Note 12 4G 启动 iOS 16，并公开了相关项目代码。
从开发者分享的演示来看，这台红米手机已经能够进入苹果标志性的 iOS 界面。系统设置中的“关于本机”页面显示，设备型号为 iPhone X，系统版本则是 iOS 16.7.16。
根据 GitHub 项目介绍，开发者将苹果开源的 XNU 内核移植到了 Redmi Note 12 4G 搭载的高通骁龙 685 平台上，同时使用来自 iPhone X 的 iOS 16.7.16 用户态组件，包括 SpringBoard 桌面、系统服务等。
整个项目基于此前 Redmi Note 10 Pro的 iOS 移植成果继续开发，并针对骁龙 685的 CPU 架构、内存管理、显示输出等进行了适配。开发者在10月18日的技术文档中表示，设备已经能够在约 3 分钟内启动至 iOS 锁屏界面。
后续消息还显示，原本无法工作的触摸屏和实体按键也已陆续调通。
目前，相关项目已在 GitHub 开源，名称为 ios-topaz。

units.text: 【点此直达升级教程】
IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，苹果今日向 iPhone 和 iPad 用户推送了 iOS / iPadOS 27.2 RC 更新（内部版本号：24B115），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 6 天。
IT之家附上本次更新相关截图如下：
图源：@tangkin
在更新内容方面，暂未查询到相比较 iOS 27.2 Beta 4 更新，iOS 27.2 RC 新增的功能。不过相比较现有 iOS 27 版本（其中 iOS 27.1 是专属于 iPhone Duo），主要变化集中在 Siri AI 语言扩展、影音应用和部分交互功能；此前测试的新版“健康”App 则已撤回，不包含在此次版本中。
Siri AI 方面，苹果新增支持英语、法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语。苹果已在此前确认这些语言扩展支持，具体可用性仍取决于用户所在地区和设备。
Apple Music 方面，换用黑白配色的新图标，并调整应用内配色，当前选中的标签页以蓝色主题色突出显示。
Apple Podcasts 方面，苹果重新设计“接下来播放”（Up Next）队列，调整播客单集的组织方式。
最值得注意的是新版“健康”App：它曾在早期测试版中出现，但苹果已在 Beta 4 恢复原有版本，相关新功能推迟至后续更新。
如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？
• 公开测试版：需注册 Apple Beta 版软件计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级；
• 开发预览版：需登录注册苹果开发者计划，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。

evidence.discovery_title: Counterpoint 数据：中国智能手机出货量 2026Q3 同比下降 10%，创 14 年新低
evidence.raw_lead: 华为与苹果合计占据 40.8% 出货量，较去年同期大幅提升。涨价导致消费者换机意愿转弱，给 2026Q4 的销售带来额外压力。
evidence.title: Counterpoint 数据：中国智能手机出货量 2026Q3 同比下降 10%，创 14 年新低

units.text: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，Counterpoint Research 最新数据显示，2026 年第三季度中国智能手机出货量同比下降 10%，创下 2012 年以来同期最低水平。而这背后主要是内存维持价格上涨、供应紧缩态势的影响。
▲ 图源：Counterpoint
从市占来看，华为与苹果合计占据 40.8% 出货量，较去年同期大幅提升。这显示出在内存成本上涨周期中，强大的高端市场布局能够带来明显的份额优势。
随着旗舰智能手机移动平台的发布，2026 年 9 月迎来一波 Android 新机浪潮。几大制造商今年在“入门旗舰”档采取了不同的产品策略：小米 18 标准版延期发布、OPPO 推出 Find X10 E、荣耀则带来 Magic9 超能版。这些决策背后是制造商对价格和销量平衡的审慎考虑。
当前成本通胀程度已经表明，越来越多的厂商无法完全消化更高的元件成本。涨价范围扩大后，消费者开始选择推迟换机、等待大促活动再购买，或者转向翻新市场选购更实惠的产品，这些行为会进一步削弱智能手机需求，给 2026Q4 的销售带来额外压力。
参考
China Smartphone Shipments Hit 14-Year Low in Q3; Huawei and Apple Buck the Downtrend

units.text: Apple is rolling out RC (release candidate) versions of iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, and more. Here’s what that means.
iPadOS 27.2 and more get RC builds ahead of launch
Apple’s lineup of 27.2 software updates is almost ready to launch.
Today Apple is rolling out RC versions of iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, and more.
Even though the current public software version of 27.0, the company is reportedly limiting 27.1 to iPhone Duo. Thus, most devices are skipping straight to 27.2.
Release candidate versions are intended to be the exact software builds that ship to all users in the public release.
It’s not unusual for Apple to discover new bugs in the RC that lead them to debut a second RC, but typically any changes in those subsequent builds are minimal.
New features in these updates include:
Messages: Suggested Actions
Apple TV: Profiles come to iPad
Apple Music: New app icon and updated design
Apple Podcasts: Overhauled Up Next queue
Siri AI: More languages supported
Home: New automation controls for compatible smart locks
plus iPad gets new Siri contextual popup
Apple is expected to launch iPadOS 27.2 and its other new updates by the end of October—likely early next week.
We’ll keep you posted on anything new in the RC builds that we discover.
Have you installed the iPadOS 27.2 RC or another RC build? Let us know of anything new you find via the comments.
*Buy iPad with 15% discount from Apple refurbished

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，在针对苹果公司创下纪录的 57 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 381.49 亿元人民币） 专利侵权判决出炉后，Taction Technology 如今进一步主张追加赔偿金、利息，同时要求苹果为未来销售的 iPhone 与 Apple Watch 持续支付专利使用费。 上月末，美国陪审团裁定，苹果的线性震动马达（Taptic Engine）侵犯了 Taction Technology 持有的两项专利，判定苹果赔偿 57 亿美元。苹果对该判决表示强烈异议，称自家技术与 Taction Technology 的技术存在本质区别，并表示将会提起上诉。 几周之后，苹果向法院申请撤销该判决或者安排重新审理，理由是 Taction Technology 未能提供支撑 57 亿美元赔偿金额的证据，导致陪审团进行了“大范围不被允许的推测估算”。 路透社发现，Taction Technology 现已提交动议，申请追加损害赔偿金、针对未来 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 销售额的持续专利使用费、自 2021 年 4 月起计算的判决前利息，以及从最终判决作出之日起直至苹果付清款项为止产生的后续利息。 Taction Technology 表示，陪审团裁定的赔偿金额只覆盖了苹果截至 2026 年 3 月的产品销量，还有接下来六个月的 iPhone、Apple Watch 销售额对应的赔偿，该公司正在追讨。 值得关注的是，Taction Technology 引用苹果此前起诉三星专利侵权案中的自身论点，来支撑本次索要持续专利使用费的诉求。 在那场诉讼里，苹果主张，专利使用费不仅适用于被认定侵权的产品，也应当覆盖采用实质相同技术的新款机型。 如今 Taction Technology 沿用这套逻辑，要求将专利费支付范围扩大至苹果最新设备，包括 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、Apple Watch Series 12 以及 Apple Watch Ultra 4。Taction Technology 称，这些产品与侵权产品之间“不存在实质性差别”。 美国陪审团此前裁定苹果 iPhone、Apple Watch 侵犯 Taction Technology 专利，需赔偿 57 亿美元。如今原告沿用苹果当年起诉三星的论点，要求追加赔偿，并要求苹果后续侵权机型持续支付专利费，目前案件仍未有定论。#苹果专利侵权案#

units.text: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，在针对苹果公司创下纪录的 57 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 381.49 亿元人民币）专利侵权判决出炉后，Taction Technology 如今进一步主张追加赔偿金、利息，同时要求苹果为未来销售的 iPhone 与 Apple Watch 持续支付专利使用费。
上月末，美国陪审团裁定，苹果的线性震动马达（Taptic Engine）侵犯了 Taction Technology 持有的两项专利，判定苹果赔偿 57 亿美元。苹果对该判决表示强烈异议，称自家技术与 Taction Technology 的技术存在本质区别，并表示将会提起上诉。
几周之后，苹果向法院申请撤销该判决或者安排重新审理，理由是 Taction Technology 未能提供支撑 57 亿美元赔偿金额的证据，导致陪审团进行了“大范围不被允许的推测估算”。
路透社发现，Taction Technology 现已提交动议，申请追加损害赔偿金、针对未来 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 销售额的持续专利使用费、自 2021 年 4 月起计算的判决前利息，以及从最终判决作出之日起直至苹果付清款项为止产生的后续利息。
Taction Technology 表示，陪审团裁定的赔偿金额只覆盖了苹果截至 2026 年 3 月的产品销量，还有接下来六个月的 iPhone、Apple Watch 销售额对应的赔偿，该公司正在追讨。
值得关注的是，Taction Technology 引用苹果此前起诉三星专利侵权案中的自身论点，来支撑本次索要持续专利使用费的诉求。
在那场诉讼里，苹果主张，专利使用费不仅适用于被认定侵权的产品，也应当覆盖采用实质相同技术的新款机型。
如今 Taction Technology 沿用这套逻辑，要求将专利费支付范围扩大至苹果最新设备，包括 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、Apple Watch Series 12 以及 Apple Watch Ultra 4。Taction Technology 称，这些产品与侵权产品之间“不存在实质性差别”。
文件原文摘录：
苹果本身就认可这一规则。当年苹果作为专利权人申请持续专利使用费时，曾向加州北区法院表示：“持续专利使用费不仅适用于陪审团认定侵权产品的持续销售，也适用于和侵权产品‘不存在实质性差别’的产品。”
针对 Taction Technology 声称构成侵权产品的后续费用，该公司请求法院强制苹果按季度提交美国地区销售报告，并且要求每季度结束后的 30 天内完成专利费结算。
依据加州法律，Taction Technology 提出判决前利息按年利率 7% 计算。该公司还请求法院将专利费支付期限延续至 2035 年 9 月 24 日，也就是涉案专利的到期日。
需要留意一个关键前提：法官尚未将陪审团的裁决定为最终生效判决。因此原本 57 亿美元的赔偿、Taction Technology 提出的新增诉求，以及苹果申请撤销判决或重审的动议，目前都还没有定论。

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple acquired AI audio editing app Samplab in June, according to a notice shared today by the European Commission. Samplab offered a desktop app and plugins for converting audio to MIDI, detecting and editing chords, stem splitting for isolating different parts of a song, and editing notes in polyphonic audio without affecting the timbre of the original. Apple could fold the company's tools into Logic Pro or GarageBand. Logic Pro already has Stem Splitter and Chord ID, but polyphonic note editing would be new. The filing says Apple acquired "certain assets" from Samplab and hired "certain Samplab employees." Apple is considered a "gatekeeper" in the European Union, and the Digital Markets Act requires it to inform the EC about deals involving core platform services, digital services, and data collection. Samplab shut down on September 17, 2026. The Samplab website now redirects to Apple.com. units.text: Apple Buys AI Audio Editing App Samplab
Apple acquired AI audio editing app Samplab in June, according to a notice shared today by the European Commission.

Samplab offered a desktop app and plugins for converting audio to MIDI, detecting and editing chords, stem splitting for isolating different parts of a song, and editing notes in polyphonic audio without affecting the timbre of the original.
Apple could fold the company's tools into Logic Pro or GarageBand. Logic Pro already has Stem Splitter and Chord ID, but polyphonic note editing would be new.

The filing says Apple acquired "certain assets" from Samplab and hired "certain Samplab employees." Apple is considered a "gatekeeper" in the European Union, and the Digital Markets Act requires it to inform the EC about deals involving core platform services, digital services, and data collection.
Samplab shut down on September 17, 2026. The Samplab website now redirects to Apple.com.

evidence.discovery_title: 非主题 / 模拟器！网友成功让小米 Redmi Note 12 手机刷入 iOS 16 系统，项目同步开源
evidence.raw_lead: 据网友 Makr 分享，其成功将一部小米 Redmi Note 12 4G 手机刷入 iOS 16 系统。据称，这不是主题、启动器和模拟器，系统设置“关于本机”里显示系统为 iOS 16.7.16、机型为 iPhone X，目前触摸和音量键都能正常使用。
evidence.title: 非主题 / 模拟器！网友成功让小米 Redmi Note 12 手机刷入 iOS 16 系统，项目同步开源

units.text: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，据网友 Makr 分享，其成功将一部小米 Redmi Note 12 4G 手机刷入 iOS 16 系统。
据称，这不是主题、启动器或模拟器，而是直接把苹果开源的 XNU 内核（苹果用于 Darwin 系统的混合内核）+ iPhone X 原版用户界面移植了过来。系统设置“关于本机”页面显示系统版本号为 iOS 16.7.16、机型为 iPhone X，触摸和音量键均能正常使用。
目前，项目已经开源（项目地址）。
作为参考，2023 年 3 月，小米举行了主题为“third time's a charm”发布活动，为海外用户带来了 Redmi Note 12 系列手机。此次面向海外用户发布的 Redmi Note 12 系列共有四款新机，分别为 Redmi Note 12（4G 版本）、Redmi Note 12 5G、Redmi Note 12 Pro 以及 Redmi Note 12 Pro+。
其中，Redmi Note 12 配备 6.67 英寸 FHD+ 分辨率显示屏，支持 120Hz 刷新，搭载骁龙 685 移动平台和 5000mAh 电池，后置 5000 万像素主摄。Redmi Note 12 5G 与前者配置基本保持一致，仅在处理器方面更换成了骁龙 4 Gen1 移动平台。
据IT之家此前报道，开发者 j0sh1x 在 10 月 7 日公布了一项复古硬件移植项目，展示了他在 HTC HD2 上成功运行 iOS 7 的成果，并公开了相关 XNU 内核及硬件支持代码。公开信息显示，该项目目前已经能够让 iOS 用户态组件在 HTC HD2 上运行，触摸屏也已实现工作。

units.text: With the tvOS 27.2 and HomePod Software 27.2 release candidates, Apple has added support for surround sound on the 2026 Apple TV 4K and for Sound Glow on select HomePods.

On October 13, as part of its "Welcome Home" event, Apple's streaming box and smallest smart speaker received meaningful hardware upgrades. A new surround sound option is also available when you pair the latest Apple TV 4K with four HomePod mini 2 units.

Alternatively, it's also possible to use four HomePod 2 speakers, or two HomePod mini 2 units and a pair of HomePod 2 speakers for the surround sound experience. Owners of the original HomePod mini and HomePod are out of luck, though cheaper, better-sounding surround sound alternatives are available.

With the tvOS 27.2 release candidate build, deployed on Monday, Apple included code related to its new surround sound feature. The company did so even though the new-and-improved Apple TV 4K won't be in users' hands before November 13.

Priced at $300, the 2026 Apple TV 4K offers a more powerful A18 chip, support for Siri AI, and far-field microphones for echo cancellation. At its core, though, the device is just a streaming box, and it's increasingly difficult to justify buying one.

Meanwhile, the HomePod Software 27.2 release candidate extends Apple's new Sound Glow feature to the HomePod 2 and original HomePod mini. With Sound Glow, the top of compatible HomePod models pulses colors that match the audio being played.
It's a neat visual detail, but nothing groundbreaking. The key selling points of HomePod mini 2 include Siri AI support and the new surround sound feature for Apple TV.

units.text: HomePod owners, have you ever wished you could disable touch controls on the top of your device? With iOS 27.2, Apple is finally adding that option. Here are the details.
HomePod touch controls can be disabled with ‘Lock Controls’ setting in iOS 27.2
If you have ever had an issue with your HomePod and phantom touches, or perhaps like me you have a young child, you may have wished for a way to disable touch controls.
According to leaker pdfu, that option is officially coming with iOS 27.2 and HomePod 27.2 next week.

All HomePod models will support the Lock Controls setting, according to HomePod software 27.2 RC. You should see the setting in the Home app after updating both HomePod and iPhone. https://t.co/lAPVuRg3av
— pdfu (@itspdfu) October 19, 2026
As seen in the screenshot above, iOS 27.2 adds a new setting for ‘Lock Controls’ inside the Home app’s HomePod accessory settings. When enabled, here’s what it does per Apple:
Prevent HomePod from playing audio or taking action when the top cap is touched. Intercom, timers, alarms, Check In and FaceTime calls will still respond to touch.

If you control your HomePod primarily through your iPhone or another device, Lock Controls is a great option to have. Particularly if you have toddlers or cats at home, or if your HomePod experiences phantom taps, you might want to disable touch interactions.
As pdfu’s post today says, this new setting is coming to all HomePod models, even the first-gen HomePod from 2018.
Do you plan to use this new HomePod setting in iOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: The iOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and HomePod Software 27.2 updates that Apple seeded today add support for four-speaker surround sound on the new Apple TV 4K ahead of its launch. Setting up a ‌HomePod‌ home theater is done directly on the ‌Apple TV‌, but there is an option to start the process with the ‌Apple TV‌ remote app on iPhone. With the fourth-generation ‌Apple TV‌ 4K, you can use four HomePod mini 2 speakers, four second-generation HomePods, or two HomePods and two ‌HomePod mini 2‌ speakers for surround sound (as long as each pair matches). The original ‌HomePod‌ and the original ‌HomePod‌ mini can't be used for surround sound, and older ‌Apple TV‌ models don't support the feature. Combining ‌HomePod‌ speakers with an ‌Apple TV‌ creates a home theater grouping, and the speakers are treated as a single accessory instead of separate audio devices. The speakers can detect their position in the room for calibrating timing and levels. The ‌HomePod mini 2‌ launches on October 30, while the fourth-generation ‌Apple TV‌ 4K comes out on November 13. Both new devices can be pre-ordered from Apple.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，据外媒 Appleinsider 报道，苹果已收购瑞士苏黎世 AI 音频编辑公司 Samplab，根据收购交易清单，苹果将收购 Samplab 的部分资产，并向该公司部分员工提供工作机会。
公开信息显示，Samplab 于 2020 年在瑞士苏黎世成立，创始人为 Manuel Fritsche 和 Gian-Marco Hutter。该公司规模较小，员工人数据信不超过 10 人。根据 LinkedIn 上的资料，甚至目前公司可能只有两位创始人在职。
Samplab 此前将自身定位为“面向 AI 时代的音乐制作”公司。在关闭前，其官方网站曾重点介绍软件的音频编辑能力，包括修改音频中的任意音符，以及识别和编辑和弦。该软件还提供公司所称的精细化音轨分离功能。
苹果自 2024 年起已在 Logic Pro 中加入 AI 音轨分离功能，可以将歌曲中的人声、吉他、鼓等元素分别提取为独立音轨，方便用户进行后续编辑。预计苹果在收购 Samplab 后，会把其相关技术整合到 Logic Pro 等创作软件中，进一步完善现有的 AI 音轨分离功能，并支持直接编辑和弦中的单个音符。

units.text: Apple's latest design showcase uses familiar objects to explore how people connect with their surroundings and each other.

Apple's second Designers of Tomorrow showcase brings four emerging design practices to Design Miami Paris. This year's Design for Presence theme explores how physical objects encourage attention, reflection, and interaction.
Curator Rodman Primack heads the exhibition, which Wallpaper* previewed ahead of its opening. Participants used Apple tools, including iPad, Apple Pencil, and MacBook Pro, to develop their work.
Image credit: Apple

Egyptian-Danish architect Salem S. Charabi created "The Eminence of Light" using materials found around his Cairo studio. The lantern combines a limestone base, a banana paper diffuser, and interlocking date palm fronds.
Image credit: Apple

"For this project, every component had to be mapped out in detail. I sketched and did all the 3D modelling on my MacBook Pro. It was a complex process getting everything to fit just right — from the carving of the stone and the paper moulds, down to the delicate base."

Brooklyn designer Isabel Rower based "The Padded Chair 1860" on a historic chair she photographed in Paris. Its fringe contains over 1,500 ceramic beads, designed to produce an appealing sound when brushed.
Image credit: Apple

"A few years ago I took a photograph of a boudoir chair from the 1860s in the Musee des Arts Decoratifs in Paris. I found the form highly unconventional and I was drawn to its dramatic fringed skirt. When faced with the prompt of 'Design for Presence', I felt that this chair was the perfect object to revisit."
Seoul artist Yoonjeong Lee's "New Form" combines a wooden table with an integrated lamp. Roughly 5,000 veneer sheets form its base, while three worn pencils secure the paper lampshade.
Image credit: Apple

"One day, I was looking at a pencil that was almost used up, and I noticed its shape looked like a nail," she told Wallpaper*. "A pencil doesn't disappear as it wears down. It stays on in a new form: as a letter, as knowledge, as music. For me, it stayed on as a nail."

Mexican studio Parafernalia developed "MonoAmbiente 1", a folding table with two stools that nest beneath it. Its acid-etched stainless steel surfaces form a continuous landscape when the furniture is closed.
Image credit: Apple

"Conversation is rarely an isolated activity. We talk while we play, eat, drink, walk, or cook. In this piece, the accompanying activities create the conditions for dialogue rather than defining it," the designers said of the piece. "The deployment of the piece marks a shift from solitary observation to shared occupation, from looking to participating."
The exhibition runs October 21 through October 25, 2026, at Hotel de Maisons in Paris.

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月19日消息，海外开发者 Makr（@makrotasuss）展示了一项相当特别的系统移植成果：成功让 Redmi Note 12 4G 启动 iOS 16，并公开了相关项目代码。 从开发者分享的演示来看，这台红米手机已经能够进入苹果标志性的 iOS 界面。系统设置中的“关于本机”页面显示，设备型号为 iPhone X，系统版本则是 iOS 16.7.16。 根据 GitHub 项目介绍， 开发者将苹果开源的 XNU 内核移植到了 Redmi Note 12 4G 搭载的高通骁龙 685 平台上，同时使用来自 iPhone X 的 iOS 16.7.16 用户态组件，包括 SpringBoard 桌面、系统服务等。 整个项目基于此前 Redmi Note 10 Pro的 iOS 移植成果继续开发，并针对骁龙 685的 CPU 架构、内存管理、显示输出等进行了适配。开发者在10月18日的技术文档中表示，设备已经能够在约 3 分钟内启动至 iOS 锁屏界面。 后续消息还显示，原本无法工作的触摸屏和实体按键也已陆续调通。 目前，相关项目已在 GitHub 开源，名称为 ios-topaz 。

units.text: Apple is rolling out the first RC for macOS 27.2 for developers and users enrolled in the public beta, ahead of the official release in the next few weeks. Here’s what to expect.
macOS 27.2 Golden Gate nears launch
After releasing macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 4 last week, Apple is now rolling out the first Release Candidate ahead of the system’s official launch in the coming weeks

macOS 27.2 adds support for five additional languages for Siri AI: French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. The feature launched last month with English-only support, with Apple promising to expand language availability during its Surprise and Shine event.

One interesting under-the-hood addition in macOS 27.2 is new gesture recognition tools in several built-in apps, which could be laying the groundwork for Apple’s upcoming touchscreen MacBook Pro, expected to be announced later this month at the Pro and Tell event.

One particularly frustrating bug reported in beta 4 causes windows in Electron-based apps to randomly stop responding to dragging attempts. Restarting the Mac temporarily resolves the issue, but it can eventually return.
The build number for macOS 27.2 release candidate 1 is 26B118. We are digging through the system and will report back if we find any noteworthy tidbits.
Installing macOS 27.2 RC
Here’s how to install the first macOS 27.2 RC:
Back up your Mac
Open System Settings
Go to General ⇾ Software Update
Click the ‘i’ icon next to Beta Updates
From the dropdown menu in the top-right, select the macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta
Hit ‘Done’
Did you spot anything new in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate RC? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: 法国近日爆发的大规模抗议活动持续升级，部分城市出现打砸、纵火和商店遭洗劫等暴力事件。当地时间10月17日，位于波尔多和里尔的两家苹果直营店先后成为袭击目标，店内商品遭到抢夺。爱马仕、路易威登等奢侈品牌门店也未能幸免，多地零售商正面临财产损失和经营中断等问题。
位于波尔多市中心圣凯瑟琳街的Apple Sainte-Catherine门店首先遭到洗劫。数小时后，位于里尔市法伊德赫布街的苹果直营店也被人闯入，店内商品遭到抢夺。两起事件均发生在10月17日法国多地抗议活动期间。
波尔多的圣凯瑟琳街是当地主要商业街之一。骚乱期间，除苹果门店外，迪卡侬、Intersport、Nocibé、Snipes等零售商也遭到不同程度的破坏或洗劫。老佛爷百货等商业场所同样受到影响，部分奢侈品牌门店成为袭击目标。
当地媒体援引法新社的报道指出，里尔苹果直营店遭到洗劫时，有记者在现场看到一名男子拿着被盗电脑离开商店。里尔市市长阿尔诺·德朗德也证实，当地苹果门店及周边其他商铺遭到洗劫。
社交媒体上随后出现了多段相关视频，显示有人进入苹果门店并携带商品离开。不过，这些视频并未全部得到官方独立核实，因此目前仍无法据此确定两家门店究竟有多少设备被盗，也无法准确评估财产损失总额。网上还有消息声称巴黎歌剧院附近的苹果直营店也遭到洗劫，但相关说法尚未得到确认。
此次事件并非孤立的零售业治安案件，而是法国近期大规模社会抗议活动的一部分。10月17日，法国多个城市举行示威游行，抗议者关注生活成本上涨、公共服务状况恶化以及教育体系面临的问题。随着游行活动发展，部分地区出现蒙面人员与警方发生冲突、纵火、破坏公共设施以及闯入商店抢夺商品等事件。
据法国媒体和通讯社报道，全国多个城市均受到波及。巴黎、马赛、波尔多、里尔等地出现商店遭洗劫、车辆起火和公共建筑受损等情况。在波尔多，地方行政长官官邸也遭到破坏，警方为应对事态出动了特种战术警察力量。
法国总统马克龙随后呼吁民众保持冷静，并表示和平示威者提出的诉求不应与实施暴力和破坏行为的人混为一谈。法国政府则表示，将采取措施恢复公共秩序，并允许地方行政部门在必要时限制特定地区的示威活动。
根据路透社10月18日的报道，法国此次骚乱造成了广泛的财产损失。法国警方在全国范围内逮捕了约2400人，近1000名警察受伤，一名示威者在巴黎抗议活动期间发生心脏骤停后死亡。法国零售商联合会方面则表示，大约1500家企业受到不同程度的影响。
法国大型零售集团家乐福也报告了严重损失。家乐福首席执行官亚历山大·邦帕尔表示，该集团约有50家门店遭到破坏，其中20家被洗劫，相关损失达到数千万欧元。除超市和体育用品商店外，电子产品零售商、手机商店及奢侈品门店同样成为袭击目标。
苹果直营店出售的iPhone、iPad、Mac等电子产品具有较高的单件价值，因而在商店遭到洗劫时面临较大的商品损失风险。不过，目前尚无可靠统计数据能够说明波尔多和里尔两家门店具体损失了多少设备，苹果公司也尚未公布针对这两起事件的详细说明。
从技术角度看，苹果设备具备激活锁等防盗保护机制，即使设备被盗，未经授权的使用者也可能难以正常激活或使用设备。但这些功能并不能阻止实体商品被抢走，也无法完全消除门店维修、停业和库存损失所带来的经济影响。
法国苹果直营店此前也曾在社会动荡期间成为袭击目标。2023年法国发生大规模骚乱时，斯特拉斯堡的一家苹果门店就曾遭到破坏和洗劫。此次波尔多与里尔两家门店同时受到冲击，再次凸显大型零售商在大规模公共秩序事件中面临的安全风险。
截至10月19日，两家苹果门店被盗商品的数量、损失金额以及后续营业安排仍不明确。随着法国各地陆续开展清理和修复工作，受影响商家正在评估损失，警方则继续处理相关案件。此次事件的最终经济影响，仍有待进一步调查和统计。

法国近日爆发的大规模抗议活动持续升级，部分城市出现打砸、纵火和商店遭洗劫等暴力事件。当地时间10月17日，位于波尔多和里尔的两家苹果直营店先后成为袭击目标，店内商品遭到抢夺。爱马仕、路易威登等奢侈品牌门店也未能幸免，多地零售商正面临财产损失和经营中断等问题。 位于波尔多市中心圣凯瑟琳街的Apple Sainte-Catherine门店首先遭到洗劫。数小时后，位于里尔市法伊德赫布街的苹果直营店也被人闯入，店内商品遭到抢夺。两起事件均发生在10月17日法国多地抗议活动期间。 波尔多的圣凯瑟琳街是当地主要商业街之一。骚乱期间，除苹果门店外，迪卡侬、Intersport、Nocibé、Snipes等零售商也遭到不同程度的破坏或洗劫。老佛爷百货等商业场所同样受到影响，部分奢侈品牌门店成为袭击目标。 当地媒体援引法新社的报道指出，里尔苹果直营店遭到洗劫时，有记者在现场看到一名男子拿着被盗电脑离开商店。里尔市市长阿尔诺·德朗德也证实，当地苹果门店及周边其他商铺遭到洗劫。 社交媒体上随后出现了多段相关视频，显示有人进入苹果门店并携带商品离开。不过，这些视频并未全部得到官方独立核实，因此目前仍无法据此确定两家门店究竟有多少设备被盗，也无法准确评估财产损失总额。网上还有消息声称巴黎歌剧院附近的苹果直营店也遭到洗劫，但相关说法尚未得到确认。

此次事件并非孤立的零售业治安案件，而是法国近期大规模社会抗议活动的一部分。10月17日，法国多个城市举行示威游行，抗议者关注生活成本上涨、公共服务状况恶化以及教育体系面临的问题。随着游行活动发展，部分地区出现蒙面人员与警方发生冲突、纵火、破坏公共设施以及闯入商店抢夺商品等事件。
根据路透社10月18日的报道，法国此次骚乱造成了广泛的财产损失。法国警方在全国范围内逮捕了约2400人，近1000名警察受伤，一名示威者在巴黎抗议活动期间发生心脏骤停后死亡。法国零售商联合会方面则表示，大约1500家企业受到不同程度的影响。

units.text: 北京时间 10 月 19 日，彭博社知名苹果记者马克 · 古尔曼 (Mark Gurman) 周日发文称，虽然苹果智能家居中枢设备 HomeView 最近才发布，但是它的研发早已完成，为了等待配套软件 Siri 只能在仓库里“吃灰”，硬件已显得过时。
HomeView
HomeView 可谓姗姗来迟，比苹果原本预期的晚了很久。古尔曼最早在 2023 年 1 月报道过这款设备，当时苹果的目标是最早在 2024 年底将其推向市场。这本应是一次相对顺利的发布，结果却变成了一场长达近两年的跳票连续剧。罪魁祸首是苹果的 AI 危机，这让公司缺少了 HomeView 绝对必需的一项技术：一个可用的、改版后的 Siri 助手。
从一开始，HomeView 就是围绕新版 Siri 设计的。这款语音助手需要能够调取用户的个人内容，识别家庭中的不同成员，并向每个人展示各自的私人信息。此外，HomeView 的设计初衷是主要通过语音而非触摸屏进行操控。如果没有一款能够正常使用的新版 Siri，苹果就无法实现最初设想的用户体验。这导致 HomeView 的硬件早已准备就绪，软件开发却远未完成。
于是，苹果一再推迟 HomeView 的发布时间，最初计划于 2025 年春季推出，随后推迟至夏季、秋季，进入 2026 年后又多次延期，直到上周才终于正式发布。这款产品的硬件配置也暴露了它的年代感。厚厚的屏幕边框、A18 处理器和 8GB 内存，都清楚地表明这是一款多年前就已开始构思的产品。实际上，成品设备早已装箱入库，在仓库里存放了大半年，等待软件开发进度赶上硬件。
有一个证据能说明这款产品已开发了很久：前苹果员工在社交媒体上发布了多条帖子，他们自豪地炫耀自己参与 HomeView 的工作。这些人并不是刚离职的。有些人已经离开苹果相当长一段时间了，却仍然能把这款新发布的设备称为自己参与打造的作品。这足以说明，这款产品的许多研发工作早在很久以前就已完成。

话虽如此，HomeView 的 299 美元售价还是挺有竞争力的。古尔曼称，苹果可能受益于提前囤积库存，在今年早些时候内存短缺推高零部件成本之前就完成了备货，从而得以将售价控制在这一水平。如今，入门级 iPad 的起售价已达到 450 美元，而 iPad mini 也即将迎来大幅涨价。相比之下，对于大多数智能家居应用场景而言，HomeView 及其内置的扬声器系统比 iPad 更加合适。这款产品的性价比之高，令人颇感意外。
但是，HomeView 也提前预告了苹果一项雄心更大的计划。苹果已经在开发一款更高端的版本，配备机械臂，可以自动将屏幕转向正在说话的人。有趣的是，苹果为这款售价 299 美元的 HomeView 制作的广告，恰恰有力地说明了为什么需要这样一款能够自动转动屏幕的升级版产品。

evidence.title: Taction wants a cut of iPhone and Apple Watch sales through 2035 - 9to5Mac

units.text: Following a historic $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict against Apple, Taction Technology is now seeking additional damages, interest, and ongoing royalties on future iPhone and Apple Watch sales. Here are the details.
Taction seeks additional compensation

Late last month, a US jury found that Apple’s Taptic Engine infringed on two patents held by Taction Technology, awarding $5.7 billion in damages. Apple strongly disputed the verdict, arguing that its technology was fundamentally different from Taction’s, and said it would appeal.

A few weeks later, Apple asked the court to overturn the verdict or order a new trial, arguing that Taction had failed to provide evidence supporting the $5.7 billion award, leaving jurors to engage in “impermissible guesswork on a massive scale.”

Now, as spotted by Reuters, Taction has filed a motion seeking supplemental damages, ongoing royalties on future iPhone and Apple Watch sales, prejudgment interest dating back to April 2021, and additional interest from the date of the final judgment until Apple pays.

According to Taction, the jury’s award only accounted for Apple’s sales through March 2026, leaving another six months of iPhone and Apple Watch sales for which the company is now seeking compensation.
Interestingly, Taction is using Apple’s own arguments from its previous patent litigation against Samsung to support its request for ongoing royalties.
In that case, Apple argued that royalties should apply not only to products found to infringe its patents, but also to newer models using essentially the same technology.

Taction is now making the same argument, seeking to extend royalty payments to Apple’s latest devices, including the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12, and Apple Watch Ultra 4, which it says “are not more than colorably different from the infringing products.”
From the filing:

Apple itself has embraced this rule. As a patentee seeking ongoing royalties, Apple told the Northern District of California that “any ongoing royalties extend not only to ongoing sales of products found to infringe by the jury, but also to products ‘not more than colorably different’ therefrom.”

units.text: Apple has acquired AI audio editing firm Samplab, likely to extend Logic Pro's existing stem splitting tools, as well as adding the ability to edit individual notes in chords.

Following its deal with the Huxe AI podcast company, Apple has now acquired Zurich-based Samplab under a similar arrangement. As detailed in the European Union's public list of acquisitions, Apple is to acquire certain assets, and offer employment to certain Samplab employees.

Samplab was founded in Hauptsitz, Zurich, Switzerland, in 2020 by Manuel Fritsche and Gian-Marco Hutter. It's believed to have no more than 10 employees and based on LinkedIn profiles, may even only employ the two founders.

The company has previously described itself as being about "music production for the age of AI." Before being closed down, its official website promoted how its software could "change any note in your audio," and "detect and edit chords."

Samplab's software also included what the firm described as granular stem separation. Since 2024, Apple's Logic Pro has had stem splitting, which uses AI to isolate vocals, guitars, drums, and so on, into separate tracks.

The company's software was available as a plugin for Digital Audio Workstations (DAW), including Logic Pro. So while neither Samplab nor Apple have commented publicly, it seems most probable that the firm's technology will be used in Apple Creator Studio and Logic Pro.
Samplab's notice to existing users before its website was rerouted to Apple's - image credit: Samplab.

According to the EU, Apple made this deal through an unnamed subsidiary on June 17. In late June, Samplab's official website posted that it was closing down, and would be refunding subscribers with the remainder of their annual subscription fee.
That official site now routes through to apple.com. Other links to Samplab plugins are currently routing to a "page not found" on Apple's site.
Samplab's Twitter channel appears to have been gutted, and its YouTube channel has definitely had its videos removed.

This acquisition is the latest of several reported to the EU, with most being small firms such as Samplab, Huxe, and Prompt AI. It bought Q.Ai in January 2026 for an estimated $2 billion, however, and reportedly may be working to make other large-scale acquisitions.

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，消息源 @itspdfu 今天（10 月 20 日）在 X 平台发布推文，报道称在适用于 HomePod 的 27.2 RC 更新中， 苹果公司扩展 HomePod mini 2 的“音乐律动灯效”（Sound Glow）功能，覆盖第二代 HomePod 和初代 HomePod mini。 IT之家查询苹果中国官网，在 HomePod mini 2 产品页中，暂未发现 Sound Glow 功能，也没有给出对应的中文译名。在功能方面，Sound Glow 功能指的是音箱顶部随音乐节奏变色、明暗律动的效果，这里暂译为“音乐律动灯效”。 该功能的看点之一，是把专辑封面的色彩“搬”到音箱上。消息称播放带有封面的音乐或播客时，顶部发光区域依据封面配色，生成呈现两到三种主要颜色，彩色光团在表面移动、跳动。 消息源在推文中指出，在 HomePod Software 27.2 RC 中，苹果设置 LightShowCapability 检查为“productType > 1”，因此只有初代 HomePod 不受支持。 启用方式上，用户将设备更新至支持该功能的 27.2 软件版本后，打开“Home”应用，长按对应 HomePod，向下找到设置中的 Sound Glow 开关，开启并播放内容即可。 对于已将 HomePod 与 Apple TV 配对的用户，还可以通过 Apple TV 控制中心里的 HomePod 菜单切换光效，方便在聚会时打开。该媒体指出该灯效并非照明，更接近点缀性的氛围光。在较暗房间里靠近白墙摆放时，墙面能映出一些色彩，即便看不到音箱顶部，也能感受到光效变化。 消息源 @itspdfu 今天（10 月 20 日）在 X 平台发布推文，报道称在适用于 HomePod 的 27.2 RC 更新中，苹果公司扩展 HomePod mini 2 的“音乐律动灯效”（Sound Glow）功能，覆盖第二代 HomePod 和初代 HomePod mini。

units.text: After pre-orders for iPhone Duo opened, Apple uploaded an EU regulatory document that finally revealed the true battery capacity for iPhone Duo: 4883mAh. Here’s how that compares to other iPhones.
4883mAh definitely falls towards the high-end of the battery spectrum, though it’s by no means the best.

iPhone Duo features two battery cells: one 2962mAh and another 1921mAh cell, totaling 4883mAh. This places it pretty much exactly in between the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, which offer 4288mAh and 5567mAh batteries, respectively.
iPhone Duo battery comparison
Compared to the rest of the recent iPhone lineup (eSIM versions, which feature larger battery cells than the physical SIM versions), here’s where iPhone Duo ranks:
Capacity | Difference | Video Playback Hours (from Apple)
iPhone 18 Pro Max | 5567mAh | +14% | 45 hours
iPhone 17 Pro Max | 5088mAh | +4% | 39 hours
iPhone Duo | 4883mAh | – | 44 hours on outer display 31 hours on inner display
iPhone 16 Pro Max | 4685mAh | -4% | 33 hours
iPhone 18 Pro | 4288mAh | -12% | 36 hours
iPhone 17 Pro | 4252mAh | -13% | 33 hours
iPhone 17e | 4005mAh | -18% | 26 hours
iPhone 17 | 3692mAh | -24% | 30 hours
iPhone Air | 3149mAh | -36% | 27 hours

Overall, iPhone Duo has one of the largest battery capacities in an iPhone, only being bested by the two most recent Pro Max iPhones. Compared to anything else, the Duo will have a physically larger battery – though it’s worth noting that you’ll get less battery life if you use the larger inside display very frequently.
Are you buying an iPhone Duo? Are you excited to receive yours, or did you also have an unfortunate pre-order experience? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: In an interview with Polygon, Apple’s new head of App Store Worldwide, Carson Oliver, discussed the company’s broader gaming ambitions, the growing number of premium iPhone games, and where Apple Arcade fits into its strategy. Here’s what he said.
New App Store chief talks App Store gaming

Apple’s ambitions to be seen as a proper gaming platform owner aren’t exactly new. Over the years, the company has repeatedly attempted to attract major game developers and convince players to take gaming on its devices more seriously, with varying degrees of success.

And those efforts show. As Apple has repeatedly highlighted during WWDC keynotes and product announcements, the company has introduced hardware-accelerated ray tracing, made significant improvements to its Metal graphics framework, and developed tools that make it easier to port PC and console games to its platforms.

Early last week, shortly after Carson Oliver’s promotion to vice president of the App Store was reported, Apple announced Indie Games Week, highlighting seven new and upcoming games for iPhone and iPad, including:
Sifu
Vampire Crawlers
No Man’s Sky
Little Kitty, Big City
9 Kings
Dome Keeper
Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall
In light of that, Polygon conducted an email interview with Oliver, who shared some interesting details about the state of gaming on the App Store and Apple’s plans for the future.
Oliver told Polygon:

“We’ve seen incredible growth of games coming to the App Store, in general, with more premium games releasing on the App Store this year than last. […] While many of those are indies, we’re also seeing more console and PC franchises coming to mobile, as it is a burgeoning audience for those games. These seven games featured in Indie Games Week capture where gaming on iPhone and iPad is heading: incredible diversity and creativity with no compromises on quality.”

Oliver also touched on the technical improvements Apple has made over the years, some of which we mentioned above, as well as the role that younger generations of players have had in shaping the mobile gaming market.
According to Oliver, “an entire generation of players” grew up with an iPhone as their first gaming device, rather than a traditional console or PC.
He added:
“These users embrace direct touch as their primary controller, making iPhone and iPad the ultimate canvas for indie innovation.”

As for Apple Arcade, and how it fits into Apple’s broader gaming strategy alongside the growing number of premium games launching directly on the App Store, Oliver told Polygon it comes down to giving game developers more flexibility:

“We want to give developers a trusted place to reach users around the world, support them at each stage, and help them build successful businesses. […] To achieve that goal, we provide developers with flexible business model options. That means a breakthrough phenomenon like Balatro can thrive as a premium download, and it can also find a home as part of the Apple Arcade service. The important thing is that we give developers the flexibility to make the best choice for every game and players the freedom to play how they want.”
To read Oliver’s full interview with Polygon, which also touches on App Store discoverability, and the types of games finding success on Apple’s platforms, follow this link.

The free browser extension allows Safari users to block ad trackers to prevent companies from spying on your web browsing and tracking you across the web. units.text: EFF's Privacy Badger Anti-Tracking Extension Expands to Safari
The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) today announced the launch of Privacy Badger for Safari on macOS.
The free browser extension allows Safari users to block ad trackers to prevent companies from spying on your web browsing and tracking you across the web.
Privacy Badger has been available on other platforms like Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, but it is new to Safari. It requires Safari 26.5 or later.

The EFF says Privacy Browser can automatically learn to block hidden trackers on the web. It uses algorithmic methods to determine what is and isn't tracking, and it doesn't block ads unless those ads are also trackers.

Safari already limits the amount of information that trackers can access, but it lets trackers load. Privacy Badger blocks the trackers from loading and techniques that bypass Safari's protections don't work.
The extension is also able to block cookies and remove link click tracking from outgoing links on Facebook and Google.

units.text: Apple's first smart home display is muscling into a market that Amazon currently dominates, with products like the popular Echo Show 8. Here's how the new HomeView compares to Amazon's counterpart.
Apple's long-rumored smart home refresh was more than just the expected updates to the Apple TV and HomePod mini. Consumers had a new device to consider adding to their abode.
The HomeView is Apple's first foray into smart home displays, as part of its fresh push into the connected home market. All to make the new and improved Siri AI the center of your digital home.
However, Apple finds itself taking on the incumbent market leaders with its first attempt at a new smart home product. That means Apple's facing off against Amazon and its Echo lineup.
Due to being the closest in terms of display size, it's worth looking at how the HomeView compares against the Echo Show 8.
While this is a comparison of specifications, that's not the entire story. The gap is as much about ecosystem as hardware.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Specifications
Specifications | Apple HomeView (Freestanding) | Amazon Echo Show 8
Launch Starting Price | $299 | $199.99
Dimensions (inches) | 5.73 wide, 5.38 to 6.82 tall, 3.78 to 5.13 deep | 8.3 x 5 x 5.9
Weight (pounds) | 2.1 | 2.3
Display | 7-inch Liquid Retina, Multi-Touch IPS, True Tone | 8.7-inch HD, Touchscreen
Processor | Apple A18 | Amazon AZ3 Pro
Voice assistant | Siri AI with Apple Intelligence | Alexa+
Camera | 12MP Center Stage, f/2.4 | 13MP with auto-framing
Audio | Two full-range drivers, Down-firing woofer, Dual passive radiators, Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos | 2.8-inch woofer, Two full-range drivers, Spatial audio
Microphones | Four | Five
Networking | Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 6, Thread | Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.4, Zigbee, Thread
Smart home hub | Home app, HomeKit, Matter, Thread | Alexa, Zigbee, Matter, Thread
Sensors | Ambient light, Temperature and humidity, Accelerometer | Ambient light Temperature Presence
Video calling | FaceTime | Alexa calling, Zoom
Colors | Silver, Starlight, Rose Pink, Space Gray | Glacier White, Graphite
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Design and build
At face value, the two models are roughly the same in terms of basic design. They both take the form of a display mounted on a speaker base.
The HomeView ships in two forms, with one being on a domed stand, with vents in the base and a stainless steel hinge holding the display. That hinge allows you to tilt the screen to a better angle.
The wall-mounted version doesn't use a stand, but instead can be fixed to the wall. This is handy if you don't particularly want to clutter up any desk or shelf space.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: HomeView from one side

The Echo Show 8, a fourth-generation model, also takes the form of a base with a display attached to the front. However, there is no hinge mechanism here, meaning you can't re-angle the display and you're stuck with the angle it's mounted at.

You can get hold of a "Premium Adjustable Stand" from Amazon, which solves the problem with a plinth underneath the base of the Echo Show 8. That means you're tilting the entire device, not just the screen.
There is no wall-mount option for Amazon's device.

Oddly, we could describe the Echo Show 8 as being somewhat reminiscent of rumors for Apple's device. The HomeView was thought to be on a half-dome similar to a HomePod, which Amazon emulates with a 3D knit cover.
Apple, meanwhile, has gone for a brushed aluminum aesthetic.
Apple HomeView
The Apple HomeView is a smart home hub, powered by an A18 chip.
Buy at Amazon
Buy at B&H
Buy at Adorama

When it comes to size, the HomeView is 5.73 inches wide, 5.13 inches deep, and 6.82 inches tall at the extremes, including the base. The wall-mounted version is 5.73 inches wide, 5.73 inches tall, and 0.39 inches thick.
The Echo Show 8 is 8.3 inches wide by 5.9 inches tall, and 5 inches deep.
The weight of the HomeView, at 2.1 pounds in total for the free-standing version, with the bulk coming from the base section. The wall-mounted model is a much lighter 10.1 ounces.
The Echo Show 8 is heavier overall at 2.3 pounds.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Display
The movable HomeView display uses a seven-inch Liquid Retina display. It's an LED-backlit IPS screen with multi-touch and True Tone.
Amazon opts for an 8.7-inch HD touchscreen, which is a little bigger. However, it's also a more conventional rectangular display compared to Apple's square version.

On resolution, Apple sits at 1,088 by 1,088, giving it a pixel density of 220 pixels per inch. While not really high compared to other Apple products, the HomeView still beats out the Echo Show 8's 179 pixels per inch.

The relatively low-quality screens aren't a massive problem, as these devices are expected to be used for smart home purposes. Both managing your home and your devices, as well as handling some video tasks.
Of course, they can be used to make video calls with other people.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: HomeView mounted on a wall

However, while the Echo Show 8 is able to stream from Prime Video, Netflix, and others, the HomeView cannot on its own. Instead, it leverages CarPlay for streaming, meaning you need an iPhone or iPad nearby, and the app needs to be CarPlay compatible for media playback.
At this time, there are no App Store plans for the HomeView, though that could always change in the future. For the moment, it's an unusual foible for Apple's hardware.
It's an interesting distinction between the two, and it certainly helps the case for Amazon's device. But, if you're at home, you've probably got a much bigger device to watch shows on elsewhere.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Camera and audio
Despite their smart home focus, the two models are fully capable of taking and making video calls.

The HomeView uses a 12MP Center Stage camera, which can be used to record footage for a FaceTime call. As the name implies, it is also able to reframe the camera, so that you're always in view and in the middle of the shot while mid-conversation.
The Echo Show 8 boasts similar capabilities, with its 13MP camera with auto-framing.

For audio, the HomeView uses a pair of full-range drivers, with a custom down-firing woofer and dual force-cancelling passive radiators in the base. The wall-mounted version just has the two full-range drivers.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Placing a FaceTime call on HomeView
There's also Spatial Audio support with Dolby Atmos, computational audio for real-time tuning, and multi-room audio playback with AirPlay. Yes, you can treat it like a really fancy HomePod.
The Echo has a 2.8-inch woofer and two full-range drivers for the same job. Amazon also claims there's room-filling spatial audio support too.
For audio recording, the Echo Show 8 uses an array of five far-field microphones at the top and base of the display.
Likewise, Apple uses a four-mic design for far-field Siri support, all in the display portion.
Though we are familiar with Apple's penchant for user privacy, Amazon goes one stage better. It has a dedicated button for enabling and disabling the camera and microphones.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Connectivity and smart home
Both displays act as a hub for a smart home. Each supports the cross-platform Matter and Thread standards, though Amazon also includes Zigbee to the party.
The HomeView carries Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 6, complete with peer-to-peer discovery on the Wi-Fi for guest access. The Echo Show 8 matches the Wi-Fi 6E radio, but with the older Bluetooth 5.4.

Apple has its well-known HomeKit support as well as the Home app, and it also supported Matter devices in recent years. Apple is also introducing quite a lot of devices from third parties as part of its new smart home push, which may help it further its platform.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Controlling a thermostat on HomeView

Amazon, too, is a massive part of the smart home industry, which gives it a massive advantage. While Matter devices will also work with the Echo Show 8, Amazon's historic support for smart home hardware and devices that support its platform is a big plus here.
You will find hardware supporting both sides, sure, but you'll tend to see items supporting Amazon Alexa more often than HomeKit, even now.
When it comes to being used, both have a fairly similar amount of services. You can play music and podcasts, as well as read things like recipes and view photographs on each.
Naturally, you can also control your smart home network from the displays.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Siri AI, Alexa, and identity
The core part of each device is its use with a digital assistant.
For Amazon, there's Alexa+, which is free for Prime users. This is a more advanced form of Alexa, which connects to other services and provides more personalization than the standard assistant.
While advanced, remember that Alexa has deep hooks into Amazon's retail empire. You're going to get a lot of shopping-related features front and center.
The HomeView runs Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence. Apple pitches broad world knowledge and natural language replies.
While each has its own ecosystem to manage, they also benefit from being able to identify you.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: You'll only see your calendar on HomeView.

Amazon has Omnisense, which uses a number of onboard sensors to respond to environmental cues and to determine which from a list of preregistered users are nearby. This uses a combination of proximity and presence detection, temperature sensing, adaptive brightness, and visual ID, namely using the camera.

While Siri AI includes things like personal context, the HomeView version relies on having a device nearby, like an iPhone or iPad, linked to your account. If it spots your device on the local network, HomeView will gladly assume you're able to view your personal content on the display.
Though it doesn't use Face ID, it does have facial recognition to shift the home screen to your personal version. Even so, you need a recently unlocked iPhone nearby too to see personal content.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Pricing

The Apple HomeView costs $299 for either the freestanding or wall-mounted model. The wall version is sold in a choice of Space Gray or Silver, with the freestanding one also gaining Starlight and Rose Pink.
As an aside, you will have to pay for a wall mount, which pushes the price up. For example, you could get a launch mount from Schneider, starting from $59.95.

The Echo Show 8 costs $199.99 without discounts, but you can get it for $149.99 right now, in Glacier White or Graphite. The version with the Premium Adjustable Stand costs $239.99, with similar periodic discounts.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: Which to buy?

It's safe to say that there's a lot of similarity between the two models. There are some small differences, like the screen resolution and size, and being able to move it at all on the HomeView without a separate stand.
The real differences here are in ecosystem and in cost.

For most people, if the cost was the same, they would want to go with which supports their existing collection of smart home-capable devices and their mobile hardware the best. For Apple users, that would be the HomeView, while more Android-centric households will err to the Echo Show 8.
The other big element, cost, is one that Amazon will almost certainly with on. Apple hardware always has a premium, while Amazon tends to service the cheaper end of the market.
Apple HomeView vs Amazon Echo Show 8: The HomeView color range
That said, a price difference of $100, without taking into account Amazon's discounts, is still a lot to consider at this price range.
Arguably Apple's ace card here, ignoring ecosystem, is its wall-mounted option. You don't have that with the Echo Show 8, and you'd have to spend $349 to do it with the Echo Show 15.
Sure, you have to get a mount for Apple's version, but you can expect cheaper options to hit the market soon instead of forking out for the pricey Schneider models.
The HomeView is certainly the premium option, but it provides a lot to its users for the money. At the very least, it gives Amazon some very healthy competition in the space.
Where to buy the Apple HomeView and Echo Show 8
Amazon's Echo Show 8 retails for $199.99, but it's currently on sale for $149.99 at the time of this comparison.
You can also pick up the larger Echo Show 15 for $349.99 at Amazon.
Apple's HomeView, meanwhile, retails for $299 from Apple directly, as well as on Amazon. You can also compare offers across popular retailers in our HomeView Price Guide.
